scope: Actual official wireguard-go/wg-quick on a disposable macOS host. One own utun with a Unicode private profile, an ordinary-user IP_BOUND_IF TCP socket, root authorization boot/socket/index/key negatives, foreign live key preservation and owned cleanup. Loopback TCP/reply inheritance and ordinary-adapter refusal are in the native CTest suite. No peer-to-peer macOS traffic, physical network, notarization or Unreal macOS claim.
